newsitem.title: USA: Venture gets $250 mln 3-year credit line.
newsitem.headline: Venture gets $250 mln 3-year credit line.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc has received a three-year commitment for a new $250 million secured revolving line of credit from BT Commercial Corp, an affiliate of Bankers Trust Co, the company said Thursday.

"As a result of this new long-term agreement, Venture will have significantly more cash available to finance the addition of new merchandise categories and the continued expansion of its successful departments," Robert Wildriek, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Venture operates 113 discount retail stores in nine states.

The $250 million credit line will be fully underwritten by FIT Commercial Corp and will replace a $225 million line. The increased facility amount, coupled with a more favorable advance rate, will provide Venture with more than $30 million in additional funding during the peak borrowing period, the retail said.
Wildrick said he is encouraged by Venture's improved store-for-store sales trends in January and February, and cost structure.
Venture has completed the first two phases of its repositioning strategy, which included new and expanded apparel, home and leisure departments.

Based on the success of these initial stages of its repositioning, Venture said it is expanding this strategy to 14 additional departments, including live plants, hardware, work clothes, golf and fishing during the third phase, starting this spring.
Shares of Venture closed at 2, unchanged from Wednesday.
